title: Summer Camp Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture session placement, unit assignment, activity choices, and support route; confirm supplies and guardian handoff.
description: Summer Camp Registration records session placement, unit assignment, activity choices, support route, supplies, and guardian handoff. Summer Camp Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this summer camp registration stage-gated verification when staff must document session placement and unit assignment. Reconcile activity choices, support route, supplies, and guardian handoff before the summer camp registration handoff. Use the application, session-capacity report, unit list, bus choice, activity permissions, support-route receipt, payment reference, packing notice, and placement confirmation. Ask the assigned summer camp registration reviewer to confirm session placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Summer Camp Registration starting details review
sections.guidance: Confirm session placement, unit assignment, optional activities, support routing, supplies, fee reference, orientation, transportation, and guardian handoff.

blocks.label: Summer Camp Registration people and reference

sections.title: Summer Camp Registration checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current summer camp registration facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Summer Camp Registration required checks
items: Session placement is identified for this record
Unit assignment matches the current request or source
Activity choices is ready for point-of-use staff
Support route limits or questions are resolved
Supplies is communicated to the responsible person
Guardian handoff is confirmed at handoff
A changed summer camp registration fact is returned for review
